instructions:
## Objective

Speed up forward and backward passes of a genomics-model block using Triton.

## Work to perform

Implement dilated depthwise convolution and whole-example normalization as hand-written autograd kernels. Keep parameters, constructor and outputs compatible; the MLP may use PyTorch. Validate input, convolution and linear-weight gradients.

## Deliverable

Committed implementation containing Triton forward/backward kernels.

## Evaluation

Numerical and identity checks gate training-step speedup against PyTorch and a reference Triton implementation on production shapes.

This is a condensed paraphrase of Emulated’s public task page. Its Prompt tab contains the full agent-facing contract; package availability is separate from publication of that prompt.
